scope: P21 shared read-only source selection and current text-block integration
behavior: Pointer ranges use actual Text nodes and endpoint offsets, never selected-text lookup or innerText. The exact current pre.textContent must match the stable successful source receipt.

The keyboard line-range form selects actual DOM text only within the current loaded source; separate confirmation focuses and requires a further explicit click or Enter. No textarea or editable DOM is used.
Candidate state is transient. Only explicit confirmation forwards the recomputed anchor; source/active/readiness changes and external interaction retire candidates without writing old opinions.
TextBlockPreview confirmation rechecks current reader, exact block, source, active, ready and no outstanding read. Its callback refers to the displayed child block, not the parent initial block.
Line availability and partial-line scope are visible. Source controls precede text and remain sticky to preserve access with long small-file previews.

api.availability: {source,available}; true only for a valid candidate, false tagged with retiring source
api.confirmation: {source,anchor}; runtime calculates strict UTF-8 byte and logical line coordinates
